title: Schneider Electric Recalls APC Surge Protectors Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The surge protectors can overheat, smoke and melt, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 15 million.

title: Calphalon Recalls Blenders Due to Injury Hazard
summary: A piece of the blender's mixing blade unit can break off during use, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 22,000 in the United States and 400 in Canada.

title: Snoopy Sno-Cone Machines Recalled by LaRose Industries Due to Risk of Mouth Injury
summary: A brass rivet can fall out of the sno-cone machine's ice-shaving cylinder and into a sno-cone, posing a risk of injury to the mouth or the teeth. Units: About 102,000.

title: HeathCo Recalls Motion-Activated Outdoor Lights Due to Electrical Shock Hazard
summary: The internal fixture wiring can energize the entire surface and fittings of the fixture, posing an electrical shock hazard. Units: About 210,000 in the U.S. and 13,000 in Canada.

title: Southern Telecom Recalls A/C Adaptors for Polaroid Internet Tablets Due to Fire Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Big Lots
summary: The adaptors can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 21,000.

title: American Honda Recalls Foreman ATVs Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The ATV's steering shaft can break unexpectedly and cause the rider to lose steering control and crash. This poses a risk of injury or death to riders. Units: 21000.

title: BreathableBaby Recalls Wearable Blanket Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The zipper pull tabs and sliders can detach posing a choking hazard to infants. Units: About 15,000.

title: Target Recalls Children's Sitting Stools Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The stabilizing bar can crack and cause the stool to collapse, posing a fall hazard to the user. Units: About 69,000.

title: Crate and Barrel Recalls Finley Hanging Pendant Lamps Due to Fire and Shock Hazards
summary: The lamp's wires can be connected incorrectly because the wires' polarity labels can fall off or be mislabeled, posing fire and shock hazards to consumers. Units: About 19,000 and 860 in Canada.

title: Emerson Air Comfort Products Recalls Tommy Bahama Outdoor Ceiling Fans Due to Risk of Injury
summary: The brackets holding the fan blades can break and cause the blades to fall, posing a risk of injury to bystanders. Units: About 2,800 in the United States, 80 in Canada.

title: Infinitoy Recalls Softimals Toy Sets Due to Choking and Aspiration Hazard
summary: The plastic hats found on playset figures pose a choking/aspiration hazard for children. Units: About 7,134 units.

title: Trail Crest Recalls Children's Hooded Sweatshirts Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The hoodies and jackets have drawstrings through the hood or neck which pose a strangulation hazard to young children. Units: About 350.
